findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice short questions for Chapter 27 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 90 questions numbered 1-90; by section: u-introduction 1, 27.1 17, 27.1.1 6, 27.2 2, 27.2.1 10, 27.2.2 7, 27.3 5, 27.3.1 3, 27.3.2 6, 27.4 2, 27.4.1 4, 27.4.2 4, 27.4.3 4, 27.4.4 3, 27.5 2, 27.5.1 6, 27.5.2 1, 27.5.3 2, u-minerals 5.

Covers the whole chapter in order (introduction, carbohydrates and 27.1.1, proteins 27.2-27.2.2, enzymes 27.3-27.3.2, lipids 27.4-27.4.4, nucleic acids 27.5-27.5.3, minerals). Comparison questions are answered as two-column tables; small numericals (n of (C₆H₁₀O₅)ₙ, glucose energy, carbonic anhydrase turnover, isoprene units, complementary DNA strand and hydrogen bonds) use new values recomputed in Python. Exercise short questions (glycogen role, glucose/fructose, cellulose/starch, competitive/non-competitive, glycolipid/lipoprotein, linkages, tertiary structure, fats/oils, steroid structure, enzyme mechanism and specificity, RNA types, mineral sources, role of iron, inhibitors in medicine) are avoided. Book corrections followed.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
